name: Incline barbell press
instructions: Set the bench to a moderate incline and keep both feet on the floor.
Grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders. Keep your wrists above your elbows.
Lower the bar towards your upper chest with control.
Press above your chest. Keep your hips on the bench.

name: Incline dumbbell press
instructions: Sit on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Keep your feet stable and your shoulder blades against the bench.
Lower the weights beside your upper chest.
Press the weights above your shoulders without striking them together.

name: Flat barbell bench press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench. Keep your feet on the floor.
Grip the bar with wrists above your elbows.
Lower towards your chest with control.
Press up and keep your hips on the bench.

name: Parallel bar dips
instructions: Support your weight on parallel bars with your arms extended.
Lower with control. Keep your shoulders stable.
Stop at a comfortable depth.
Press back to the supported position.

name: Dumbbell fly
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with the weights above your chest.
Keep a slight bend in both elbows.
Open your arms to a comfortable range without forcing a stretch.
Bring the weights back above your chest with the same elbow bend.

name: Pec deck
instructions: Set the seat so the handles are near chest height.
Keep your back against the pad and feet on the floor.
Bring the handles together in front of your chest.
Return with control.

name: Triceps pushdown
instructions: Stand facing a high cable with elbows beside your ribs.
Start with bent elbows and wrists straight.
Extend your elbows and press the handle down.
Return without moving your upper arms forward.

name: Overhead dumbbell extension
instructions: Hold one dumbbell with both hands above your head.
Keep your trunk stable and upper arms near your head.
Bend your elbows to lower the weight behind your head.
Extend your elbows without arching your back.

name: Barbell curl
instructions: Stand with the bar at your thighs, palms forward.
Keep your elbows beside your trunk.
Bend your elbows to raise the bar.
Lower without swinging your body.

name: Dumbbell curl
instructions: Stand with one dumbbell in each hand.
Turn your palms forward and keep elbows beside your trunk.
Curl both weights without leaning back.
Lower with control.

name: Pull-up
instructions: Grip an overhead bar and hang with a controlled shoulder position.
Pull your elbows down as you raise your body.
Bring your chin above the bar without reaching your neck forward.
Lower with control.

name: Lat pulldown
instructions: Adjust the thigh pad and place both feet on the floor.
Grip the bar overhead. Keep your chest lifted.
Pull the bar in front of your face towards your upper chest.
Return overhead with control. Never pull behind your neck.

name: Barbell row
instructions: Hinge at your hips with a slight knee bend.
Keep your back stable and let the bar hang below your shoulders.
Pull the bar towards your lower ribs.
Lower the bar without changing your trunk angle.

name: One-arm dumbbell row
instructions: Support one hand and knee on a bench.
Hold the weight below the other shoulder with your back stable.
Pull your elbow towards your hip.
Lower with control. Repeat on the other side.

name: Face pull
instructions: Set a rope cable near face height.
Stand stable and hold the rope with arms extended.
Pull the rope towards your face and separate your hands.
Return with control without leaning back.

name: Barbell back squat
instructions: Place the bar across your upper back, clear of your neck.
Stand with a stable foot position and brace your trunk.
Bend your hips and knees while keeping heels grounded.
Stand up with knees aligned with your feet.

name: Leg press
instructions: Adjust the seat and place your feet on the platform.
Keep your back and hips against the pad.
Bend your knees only as far as your hips remain supported.
Press the platform away without forcefully locking your knees.

name: Barbell Romanian deadlift
instructions: Stand with the bar at your thighs and knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and keep the bar close to your legs.
Lower only as far as you can keep your back stable.
Drive your hips forward to stand. Do not lean back.

name: Leg extension
instructions: Align your knees with the machine pivot.
Place the roller above your ankles and hold the handles.
Extend your knees with control.
Lower the roller without lifting your hips.

name: Standing barbell calf raise
instructions: Secure the bar on your upper back and use a stable support setup.
Place the balls of your feet on the step.
Raise your heels while keeping your knees stable.
Lower your heels with control.

name: Dumbbell rear delt fly
instructions: Hinge at your hips and keep your back stable.
Let the weights hang with a slight elbow bend.
Raise your arms out to the sides.
Lower without swinging or changing your trunk angle.

name: Barbell overhead press
instructions: Stand with the bar at your upper chest.
Brace your trunk and keep knees steady.
Press the bar overhead, moving your head clear of its path.
Lower to your upper chest with control.

name: Seated dumbbell overhead press
instructions: Sit against a supported bench with feet flat.
Hold the weights at shoulder height.
Press overhead without arching your back.
Lower to shoulder height with control.

name: Dumbbell lateral raise
instructions: Stand with the weights beside your thighs.
Keep elbows slightly bent.
Raise your arms out to about shoulder height.
Lower without swinging.

name: Close-grip bench press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with feet grounded.
Use a grip near shoulder width and keep wrists stable.
Lower the bar towards your chest with elbows near your sides.
Press up with control.

name: Hammer curl
instructions: Stand with dumbbells at your sides and palms facing inward.
Keep elbows beside your trunk.
Curl the weights with palms still facing inward.
Lower without swinging.

name: EZ-bar curl
instructions: Grip the angled parts of the bar with palms facing upward.
Keep your elbows beside your trunk.
Curl the bar without moving your shoulders forward.
Lower with control.

name: One-arm kettlebell row
instructions: Hinge at the hips and support your free hand.
Let the kettlebell hang below your shoulder.
Pull the bell towards your lower ribs without rotating your trunk.
Lower and repeat on the other side.

name: Strict kettlebell press
instructions: Hold one kettlebell in the rack beside your shoulder.
Keep the wrist straight and the bell against the forearm.
Press overhead with no leg drive.
Lower to the rack with control. Repeat on the other side.

name: Kettlebell goblet squat
instructions: Hold one bell close to your chest with both hands.
Brace your trunk and keep heels grounded.
Bend your hips and knees into a controlled squat.
Stand while keeping the bell close to your chest.

name: Two-hand kettlebell swing
instructions: Place the bell in front of you and hinge to grip it with both hands.
Hike it back between your thighs with a stable back.
Extend your hips to let the bell float to chest height. Do not lift with your arms.
Let the bell fall and hinge again as it returns between your thighs.

name: Barbell deadlift
instructions: Stand with the bar over midfoot, close to your shins.
Bend at hips and knees to grip the bar and brace your trunk.
Push through the floor and stand with the bar close to your legs.
Return the bar by moving your hips back, then bending your knees.

name: Trap-bar deadlift
instructions: Stand in the centre of the trap bar.
Bend hips and knees to grip both handles.
Brace your trunk and stand with the handles at your sides.
Lower the bar with control.

name: Push-up
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands near shoulder width.
Keep your trunk and hips in one line.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest towards the floor.
Press up without letting your hips sag.

name: Double kettlebell front squat
instructions: Rack one bell beside each shoulder with straight wrists.
Keep elbows near your trunk and brace your body.
Squat with heels grounded and both bells held in the rack.
Stand with the bells still in the rack. Count one rep for the paired movement.

name: Single kettlebell clean and press
instructions: Hinge and hike one bell between your legs.
Extend your hips and guide the bell close to your body into the rack. Do not flip it onto your wrist.
Pause in the rack with a straight wrist.
Press overhead, then lower to the rack and return to the hinge. Repeat on the other side.

name: Double kettlebell clean and press
instructions: Hinge and hike both bells between your legs.
Extend your hips and guide both bells close into the front rack.
Pause with straight wrists and a stable trunk.
Press both bells overhead. Return to the rack, then the hinge. Count one rep for the pair.

name: Turkish get-up
instructions: Lie on your back with the bell in your right hand, right arm vertical, right knee bent and left leg extended.
Roll to your left elbow while keeping the bell above your shoulder.
Press onto your left hand.
Raise your hips to make space for your left leg.
Sweep the left knee under your hips to a supported kneeling position.
Lift your left hand and align into an upright half-kneel.
Stand. Reverse each step with control. Repeat on the other side.
